settings.title: Grow lights for greenhouse and seedling setups.
settings.content: Seedlings and greenhouse benches need practical coverage across wider growing areas.

settings.title: The seedling problem
settings.content: Seedlings and greenhouse starts often need even coverage across trays, shelves, or bench space.

settings.title: Recommended setup
settings.content: Use string, linear, or multi-light setups that can cover a wider area and adapt as trays move.

settings.title: Soliseed greenhouse string lights
settings.content: A wider setup option for greenhouse accessories, seedlings, and plant benches.

settings.title: Setup tips
settings.content: Check coverage across the whole tray area and adjust height or spacing when seedlings are moved.

settings.title: Do seedlings need flexible placement?
settings.content: Often yes. Seedlings move quickly from tray to pot, so a flexible setup can make daily adjustments easier.

settings.title: Cover the growing area, not just one plant.
settings.content: For greenhouse and seedling setups, think about spread, height, and easy adjustment.
